# Ingredient cost calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/ingredient-cost/

Calculate ingredient cost from pack size, pack price and recipe usage. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Find the cost of 200 g of flour bought as a 1 kg pack at an entered price.

## Limits and checks

Use matching quantity units for each ingredient. The tool does not automatically convert volume to weight without ingredient density.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
